description_for_human: Real-time executive intelligence for SmartUp ERP: student metrics, fee collections & pending dues, branch health, and attendance.
description_for_model: Plugin for accessing real-time SmartUp ERP data for the Director and Management. Allows checking total and active students (1549 active, 103 discontinued across 9 branches), fee collections (total billed ₹30M, collected ₹13.8M, pending ₹16.2M), branch breakdowns, and 360-degree student lookups.
